fact: The dashboard was already booting on metal -- the kernel serves it on every interface it has and the supervisor probes it ONLINE -- so the gap was reachability, not the platform. Closed by binding 0.0.0.0, by deriving a link-local address from the interface's own MAC when no ip= is configured, and by ending every boot with a DASHBOARD: line that names the URLs or says NO CARRIER when the cable is the problem, with the link state read from /sys/class/net/<dev>/carrier (the kernel's own answer) rather than from a driver log line.
not_claimed: The link-local address is DERIVED from the MAC, not collision-probed. A service the kernel serves itself is declared in the service table, never spawned -- the dashboard's status row is the supervisor's own HTTP probe.

fact: The radio's userspace prerequisites are in the image and were verified by CONTENT: decompressing the initrd's own cpio showed all 22 modules and all four firmware files byte-identical to the staged copies, and the boot reported '22 loaded, 0 not shipped'. The module list is DERIVED -- modprobe --show-depends <driver> named libarc4 and led-class, which a hand-written list misses. The firmware NAME was read out of the module itself (iwlwifi-cc-a0-77) and its PATH out of linux-firmware's own WHENCE, because the root names there are symlinks and a plain root fetch 404s. fact: The supplicant's two machine-checkable halves are proven against implementations that are not itself. fact: The association is written and its arithmetic is proven. CONNECT carries the preshared key in NL80211_ATTR_PMK (254) -- the header is explicit that there is no ATTR_PSK, and the value it takes is the PMK itself, which is what pbkdf2_sha1_32 already produces. The four EAPOL frames are parsed and built with the MIC taken over the frame with the MIC FIELD ZEROED, which is the single most common way a handshake fails in silence. Message 3's MIC is verified against the PTK and its AES key-wrap is REFUSED on failure, because that integrity word is the only thing that catches a PTK derived from the wrong nonces. The oracle checks the frames, not only the primitives: the PTK recomputed from the printed nonces, the msg2 and msg4 MICs recomputed over the frames, the RSN element message 1 carried echoed back byte for byte, and the GTK round trip -- all identical.
corrected: Re-deriving this round found one wrong ABI number in the PREVIOUS round's source: NL80211_ATTR_CIPHER_SUITES_PAIRWISE was written as 81 and is 73. Nothing inside the program can distinguish a wrong attribute number from a driver that did not answer, which is why derive_nl80211_consts.py --check now diffs all 34 constants against the kernel's own uapi header.
not_claimed: An association. CONNECT has never been sent to an access point and no four-way handshake has run against one: no wiphy is registered on any machine in this environment. The frames are proven; the exchange is not. The launcher also says plainly when the volume carries no credentials, because an unconfigured radio and a wrong passphrase must not read the same in a boot log.
